text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, August 25, 2023, Appeal DDRT2023-28.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded on consent of the parties the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the Applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued August 25, 2023, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Jaroslaw Kozlowski, and their Counsel, and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before February 2, 2024.
